rounds.text: Indus Finance Ltd is demonstrating exceptional fundamental momentum, highlighted by a trailing twelve-month compounded sales growth of 54% and a corresponding profit growth of 65% [E17, E21]. This top and bottom-line acceleration is backed by impressive medium-term performance, including a 3-year compounded sales growth of 51% and an 84% surge in profit growth over the same period [E16, E20]. Operational efficiency shines through a robust ROCE of 15% and an ROA of 5.9%, both significantly outperforming sector benchmarks where sector median ROCE sits at a modest 6.1% [E8, E10, E12, E70]. Market recognition of this strength is reflected in a stellar relative-strength rating of 100 against the Nifty 500 alongside a rules-based screen score of 79 out of 100 pointing to a BUY rating [E44, E58]. Furthermore, the company benefits from a broader financial services sector tailwind with a score of 0.83, and management has actively reduced debt while maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 35.8% [E52, E54, E67]. Conceded: [E38] showing a discounted cash flow intrinsic value of Rs 89 against a market price of 155.
